MQM evaluation procedure with error typologies and severity levels (major/minor)

Following the prior study , we hired 3 bilingual linguists in English and German. Following MQM evaluation procedure , each rater can only access the source (in German) and model output (in English), without any reference text. Rater is given all the choices of possible error typologies and definitions of the severity levels.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally good but included some items that were mentioned in passing rather than actually evaluated. The paper focuses on evaluating SESCORE2 across Machine Translation, Dialogue Generation, and Data-to-Text tasks using both automatic metrics and human evaluation with MQM framework. Text summarization is mentioned in the abstract but not actually evaluated in the experiments.
